severity: OPEN -- affects whether rendered rollouts can corroborate stored evaluations
claim: Rendering the SAME checkpoint on the SAME frozen conditions in the SAME deterministic mode reproduces the stored evaluation for non-lifting conditions but NOT for lifting ones.

evidence.checkpoint: runs/rlpd/rlpd_ckpt_step415140.pt (identical path and env_steps in both)
evidence.rendered: 0 carries, 0 throws, 0 lifts; every condition grasp-only, return 2.32-2.58
evidence.agreement_where_no_lift: cond 46 stored disp 0.0143 vs rendered 0.0175; cond 32 stored 0.0037 vs rendered 0.0110 -- both grasp-only in both runs, returns ~2.4 in both
evidence.divergence_only_on_lifts: every disagreement is a condition where the stored sweep recorded a lift

ruled_out.code_drift: vlm_encode and sample_action are byte-identical between eval_checkpoint.py and render_rollouts.py (AST comparison, matching SHA-256). The only eval_checkpoint.py change since the stored run adds recorded fields, not behaviour.
ruled_out.wrong_checkpoint: both record checkpoint_env_steps 415140 and the same file path
ruled_out.wrong_suite: all rendered rollouts pass the frozen-suite hash check
ruled_out.sweep_position_drift: lifts in the stored sweep occur at scattered indices (3,16,19,20,21,31,39,41), not a contiguous run, so this is not simple state accumulation across the 50-episode sweep

leading_hypothesis: The renderer reads sc['front_camera'].data.output every other control step INSIDE run_chunk; the evaluator never touches the camera mid-chunk. In IsaacLab a sensor read can drive a render/update, changing sub-step timing. On a contact-rich grasp this is a plausible cause of a lift either occurring or not.
test_in_flight: NO_CAPTURE=1 re-renders conditions 3,20,21,31,39,41 with frame capture disabled, making the rollout path identical to the evaluator. If lifts reappear, capture is the cause.
implications_if_confirmed: Videos of LIFTING behaviour cannot be produced by this capture method without perturbing the very behaviour being filmed.
The stored evaluations remain the measurement of record; the rendered rollouts would corroborate only non-lifting outcomes.
A workaround would be to capture frames only between chunks, or to re-render with capture at a cadence that does not interleave with physics sub-steps.
not_yet_established: Whether the divergence is caused by capture, or whether this task's grasp is simply non-deterministic across processes. A third possibility is GPU non-determinism in the VLM forward pass changing the action chunk slightly, which a contact-sensitive task could amplify.
does_not_affect: The SFT stochastic finding, which was replicated by rendering (success 0.16 vs stored 0.16) and whose successes were themselves rendered with capture enabled.
